resources.string:
Your charts, records and settings stay on your phone (and in the Android backup, if it is on). What leaves it:

• Ranking: your name, your best scores (with song, artist and table: phone or PC) and a random code for each device go to a spreadsheet owned by the developer of Riff on Google; the name and scores are shown in the ranking to everyone. Using the same name on another device (with the link code) joins several devices under the same name.
• Report: the text, the email (if you add one) and, if left on, the device information go to the developer, also through Google.
• Charts: the searches you make go to Encore (enchor.us), where downloads also come from.

To remove your name and scores from the ranking, ask through Report.

Your charts, records and settings stay on your PC. What leaves it:

• Ranking: your name, your best scores (with song, artist and table: phone or PC) and a random code for each device go to a spreadsheet owned by the developer of Riff on Google; the name and scores are shown in the ranking to everyone. Using the same name on another device (with the link code) joins several devices under the same name.
• Report: the text, the email (if you add one) and, if left on, the PC information (the Riff version, the system and the language) go to the developer of Riff, through Google.
• Charts: the searches you make go to Encore (enchor.us), where downloads also come from.

To remove your name and scores from the ranking, ask through Report.
